## Change

Describe the behavior or documentation changed and link the relevant issue. Open an issue first for large changes.

## Evidence

List commands run and their results. State what was not exercised, especially for hardware or field claims.

## Publication and sign-off

- [ ] No secrets, private data, vendor CAD/datasheets, or machine-specific paths are included.
- [ ] Third-party attribution and path-specific licensing in [NOTICE](../NOTICE) are respected.
- [ ] Commits carry the DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
